safety session Location Broadcast:

Zero Advance Transfer Rule:
NEVER transfer money, token advances, gate passes, or "room holding reserves" via UPI or bank transfer before physically verifying the property and the registered owner.

2 months' base rent
(e.g., ₹40,000 per person in the above case). Treat this as a segregated capital outlay — never pool this money into unsecured personal accounts without clear co-signed documentation.
Most residential leases across Haryana, Delhi, and Uttar Pradesh are executed as an
11-Month Leave and License Agreement
to bypass protracted tenancy litigation under traditional Rent Control acts.
Notice & Lock-in Periods
Verify if your contract contains an initial lock-in period (commonly 3–6 months). Ensure the standard mutual notice period is 30 to 60 calendar days with clear communication avenues.
e-Stamping & Attestation
Leases must be executed on verified non-judicial e-stamp paper (value between ₹100 and ₹500 depending on regional state rules in Delhi, Haryana, or UP) and notarized.
Important Notice

This page represents operational community guidelines and peer guidance — it does not constitute formal legal counsel. Tenancy regulations and enforcement bodies vary significantly across the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority (GMDA), and Noida Authority.
Unfair deductions from security deposits are the single most prevalent conflict reported by tenants in Delhi NCR. Protect your capital with on-day-one digital inventory mapping.
The Day-1 Move-In Checklist:
Timestamped 4K video walk of all skirting boards, window latches, and ceilings.
Close-up photographs of pre-existing dampness, water seepage, or drill holes.
Testing geysers, air conditioners, chimneys, and RO water purifiers in presence of the agent.
Written counter-sign by landlord/current tenants confirming deposit distribution.
Shared domestic spaces succeed when explicit boundaries replace assumed courtesies. Establish a clear written roommate covenant during your first week.
Quiet Hours & WFH Respect
Agree on common quiet intervals (e.g. 11:00 PM to 7:30 AM). Keep phone calls and high-volume speakers inside private rooms during peak corporate working hours.
Overnight Guests & Advance Notice
Enforce a minimum 12-hour WhatsApp group heads-up before hosting overnight friends, family, or partners to maintain comfort and mutual respect in common zones.
Career transitions and relocations are natural. To maintain lease stability, departing tenants must not leave the remaining flatmates financially encumbered.
Flatrimony Replacement Protocol
Departing co-tenants should activate the
Flatrimony Replacement Finder

at least 30 days prior to their planned exit. The existing tenants retain absolute veto rights over lifestyle alignment, ensuring incoming housemates match the household's cleanliness, culinary, and social parameters before executing lease novation.
Reclaiming your capital cleanly requires documentation rather than confrontation. Leverage your original verified record to resolve final settlements.
Move-Out Audit
Compare room states side-by-side with day-one photo records to disprove arbitrary repainting or wear-and-tear claims.
Utility Clearance
Procure official final meter readings for DHBVN/UPPCL power and piped natural gas (PNG) to settle accounts to the exact day.
Written Refund Timeline
Get a signed bank transfer timeline (usually 7 to 14 days post-handover) on the landlord's official WhatsApp or letterhead.
